description: These official statistics count completions under the Help to Buy equity loan scheme in England, which lent to buyers of new-build homes, with totals and loans to first-time buyers. They are published by the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government in a GOV.UK collection of 44 releases, first created in November 2013; the last release covers data to 31 May 2023 and was updated in February 2024. Breakdowns on data.gov.uk include local authority district, parliamentary constituency, postcode district and postcode sector. From March 2015 the Homes and Communities Agency revised the whole series to use expected completion dates instead of payment dates, and allocation to postcode sectors uses the latest full postcode for each sale. Coverage is England from April 2013. Access: releases on GOV.UK; the data.gov.uk entries point to Open Data Communities linked-data pages and a SPARQL endpoint, which returned HTTP 403 today. Licence: Open Government Licence; free. Caveats: the scheme has closed, and figures for some local authorities were subject to revision. Simulation uses: the location and pace of new-build housing for building stock growth models. Related records: the England and Wales energy performance certificates.
